cards.name: Example Silent Knight
cards.effect: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Example" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Example Silent Knight" once per turn.

cards.name: Example Rewind
cards.effect: Target 1 "Example" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

cards.name: Adorahorror Odogar
cards.effect: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can increase or reduce the Level of a monster on the field by 2; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 9 or higher DARK Tuner from your hand or GY. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can add 1 "Adorahorror" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Adorahorror Odogar", then if you control 2 or more Synchro Monsters, you can add 1 second such card. You can only use each effect of "Adorahorror Odogar" once per turn.
